title: Many objects not accessible using redis or cassandra as filerstore
body:
Sponsors SeaweedFS via Patreon https://www.patreon.com/seaweedfs
Report issues here. Ask questions here https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/seaweedfs
Please ask questions in https://github.com/seaweedfs/seaweedfs/discussions

**Describe the bug**
Hi,
I don't know if it's a bug or misuse on my part.When i try to use Cassandra or Redis as filerStore, many objects becomes not accessibles via S3 but I can see them using weed mount FS.
I have try to switch beetwen different filerstore and when I put leveldb2 back, everything works fine again.
I'm not experienced with redis and cassandra but it looks like the stored metadata is badly stored due to accents and spaces in the filenames. Are there any necessary options for these filerstores?

**System Setup**

weed master -ip=192.168.1.28 -ip.bind=0.0.0.0 -mdir=/home/weed-master
weed volume -dir=/home/storage/toshiba -max=0 -mserver=192.168.1.28:9333 -ip=192.168.1.28 -ip.bind=0.0.0.0 -port=8082
weed volume -dir=/home/storage/western -max=0 -mserver=192.168.1.28:9333 -ip=192.168.1.28 -ip.bind=0.0.0.0 -port=8083
weed volume -dir=/home/storage/seagate -max=0 -mserver=192.168.1.28:9333 -ip=192.168.1.28 -ip.bind=0.0.0.0 -port=8084
weed filer -ip=192.168.1.28 -ip.bind=0.0.0.0
weed -logdir=/var/log/weeds3 s3 -allowEmptyFolder -ip.bind=0.0.0.0 -config /etc/seaweedfs/config.json -port=23890

- OS Rocky Linux 8.7
- version 8000GB 3.49 2e351aa96735ab2d1e4c20d0973d0653820b4cd4 linux amd64
Content of `filer.toml`

[cassandra]
enabled = false
keyspace="seaweedfs"
hosts=[
    "192.168.1.28:9042",
]
[filer.options]
recursive_delete = false
[leveldb2]
enabled = true
dir = "/home/weed-filer/filerldb2"
[redis]
enabled = false
address  = "192.168.1.28:6379"
password = "mysuperpassword"
db = 2


**Expected behavior**
I would like to use redis or Cassandra but this behavior does not allow me to do so because the S3 gateway is essential for my needs.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
